description: This file defines the ZAiHandler class, a provider for handling AI chat completions with special support for 'thinking' mode, integrating with various models and configurations.

classes.name: ZAiHandler
classes.description: A class extending BaseOpenAiCompatibleProvider to handle AI chat completions with support for 'thinking' mode and model configurations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ZAiHandler with options, setting model configurations based on region.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle GLM-4.7's thinking mode, enabling or disabling reasoning explicitly.

methods.name: createStreamWithThinking
methods.description: Creates a chat completion stream with explicit control over reasoning ('thinking') mode.
